name: DiffPool
tagline: Hierarchical pooling that learns a soft cluster assignment matrix to coarsen the graph into super-nodes.
formula: $$ S = \mathrm{softmax}_{\text{nodes}}(\mathrm{MLP}(X)),\quad X' = S^\top X,\quad A' = S^\top A S $$
diff_from_baseline: Ying et al. 2018 (NeurIPS). Differentiable hierarchical pooling: a learned soft assignment matrix maps nodes to a fixed number of clusters; the coarsened graph is mean-pooled to produce the graph embedding.

name: GIN JK-Sum
tagline: Original GIN readout: sum-pool node features at each layer, batch-norm, then concatenate (Jumping Knowledge).
diff_from_baseline: Xu, Hu, Leskovec & Jegelka 2019 (GIN, ICLR). Sum readout over each layer's node embeddings followed by Jumping-Knowledge concatenation, the original GIN graph-classification readout. Per-layer BatchNorm stabilizes training across folds.

name: SAGPool (hierarchical)
tagline: Self-attention graph pooling: score nodes via GNN attention, keep top-k twice, concat sum+mean readouts at three resolutions.

key_hyperparams.name: ratio
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of nodes kept per pool layer

diff_from_baseline: Lee, Lee & Kang 2019 (ICML). Hierarchical pooling with self-attention scores selecting the top-k informative nodes, applied here as a two-level coarsening with sum+mean readouts at each resolution.

name: GMT
tagline: Graph Multiset Transformer: pooling-by-multihead-attention with a learnable seed vector cross-attending to padded node features.
diff_from_baseline: Baek, Kang & Hwang 2021 (GMT, ICLR). Set-Transformer-based readout: a learnable seed token attends to all node features, capturing multiset structure. Strong attention-based readout on molecular and bio graph datasets.

name: Set2Set
tagline: LSTM with attention iteratively reads the node set; the final query+attended-context produces a permutation-invariant pooled vector.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize LSTM hidden state $q_0 = 0$
2. for $t = 1 \ldots T$ do (here $T=6$)
3.   $a_{v,t} = \mathrm{softmax}_v(q_t^\top h_v)$ over nodes $v$ in graph
4.   $r_t = \sum_v a_{v,t}\, h_v$
5.   $q_{t+1} = \mathrm{LSTM}([q_t, r_t])$
6. end for
7. Output $[q_T, r_T] \in \mathbb{R}^{2d}$, projected to $\mathbb{R}^d$ by a Linear layer
diff_from_baseline: Vinyals, Bengio & Kudlur 2016 (ICLR). Order-invariant set readout where an LSTM repeatedly attends over node embeddings; widely used as the readout in MPNN-style molecular property predictors.

name: SortPool (DGCNN)
tagline: Sort nodes by their last-channel activation, truncate/pad to size k, then 1D-conv over the sorted sequence.
pseudocode:
1. For each graph in the batch, sort node embeddings by the last channel value (WL-color proxy)
2. Truncate or zero-pad the sorted sequence to length $k = 30$
3. Reshape $[B, 1, k\cdot d]$ and apply Conv1d with kernel $d$, stride $d$ to produce 16 channels of length $k$
4. ReLU and flatten to $[B, 16k]$
5. Linear projection to hidden_dim
diff_from_baseline: Zhang, Cui, Neumann & Chen 2018 (DGCNN, AAAI). Sort-based readout treating sorted node embeddings as a 1D sequence and applying a CNN. Common DGCNN/SortPool reference for graph classification.
